problem.title: Check Whether Two Nodes are Siblings
problem.problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree and two distinct node values, determine whether both nodes share the same parent.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree. • The last line contains two node values.
problem.output: • Print YES if the nodes are siblings; otherwise print NO.
